label: M1 loader:ID 重複放行 → control-catalog.test「id 重複」轉紅
M2 checker:implementation 不驗 tracked → e2e (x) path.untracked 轉紅
M3 checker:反向鎖(3e)拿掉 → e2e (vii) unregistered 轉紅
M4 checker:渲染一致比對拿掉 → e2e (ix) doc.drift 轉紅
M5 loader:hard-automated 可寫 --no-verify → bypass 一致性測試轉紅
M6 loader:untested 可混用 → tested 一致性測試轉紅
M7 loader:3c 交集檢查拿掉(把 Test (vitest) 搬進 setup 仍綠)→ e2e (i) 與 loader 測試轉紅
M8 checker:3b 缺名稱檢查拿掉 → e2e (iii) setup.missing 轉紅
M9 loader:ciSetupSteps(所有陣列)重複檢查拿掉 → 重複負對照轉紅

find:
for (const x of findings) console.log(`  [${x.code}] ${x.msg}`);
  return 2;
replace:
for (const x of findings) console.log(`  [${x.code}] ${x.msg}`);
  return 0;
label: M10 checker main:有 findings 仍 exit 0 → e2e 負對照(exit 2 斷言)轉紅

find: if (ciStep === null) fail(`${id}:hard-automated 且 triggers 含 push / pull_request → ciStep 必填`);
replace: if (false) fail(`${id}:hard-automated 且 triggers 含 push / pull_request → ciStep 必填`);
label: M11 loader:hard+CI 的 ciStep 可 null → e2e (ii) 與 ciStep 一致性測試轉紅
